info.title: Matomo Reporting API for CustomReports plugin

get.description: Duplicates a custom report to one or more websites.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The numeric ID of the website that owns the source custom report.

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to duplicate.

parameters.name: idDestinationSites
parameters.description: Website IDs to copy the custom report to. Defaults to [$idSite] when omitted.

200.description:
Response indicating whether the duplication succeeded and, on success, the new report ID.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Creates a new custom report definition.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID that owns the report, or "all"/0 when creating a shared report for multiple websites.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The report name.

parameters.name: reportType
parameters.description: Report type to create, for example "table", "evolution" or "kpicard".

parameters.name: metricIds
parameters.description: Metric IDs to include in the report.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Category ID to place the report in. Uses the default custom reports category when omitted.

parameters.name: dimensionIds
parameters.description: Dimension IDs to include in the report.

parameters.name: subcategoryId
parameters.description: Subcategory ID to place the report in. Creates a new reporting page when omitted.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional report description shown in the report help tooltip.

parameters.name: segmentFilter
parameters.description: Optional URL-encoded segment applied to the report data.

parameters.name: multipleIdSites
parameters.description: Optional website IDs to assign the report to when creating a shared report.

200.description:
The ID of the newly created custom report.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Updates an existing custom report definition.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: Website ID that owns the report, or "all"/0 when updating a shared report.

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to update.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The report name.

parameters.name: reportType
parameters.description: Report type to store, for example "table", "evolution" or "kpicard".

parameters.name: metricIds
parameters.description: Metric IDs to include in the report.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Category ID to place the report in. Uses the default custom reports category when omitted.

parameters.name: dimensionIds
parameters.description: Dimension IDs to include in the report.

parameters.name: subcategoryId
parameters.description: Subcategory ID to place the report in. Creates a new reporting page when omitted.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional report description shown in the report help tooltip.

parameters.name: segmentFilter
parameters.description: Optional URL-encoded segment applied to the report data.

parameters.name: subCategoryReportIds
parameters.description: Child report IDs mapped to this report.

parameters.name: multipleIdSites
parameters.description: Optional website IDs to assign the report to when updating a shared report.

get.description: Returns all configured custom reports for a website.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The website ID to query, or "all" for reports shared across all websites.

parameters.name: skipCategoryMetadata
parameters.description: Whether to omit category metadata from each returned report.

200.description:
The configured custom reports for the requested website.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

get.description: Returns a specific custom report configuration.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The website ID to query, or "all" for a report shared across all websites.

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report.

200.description:
The configured custom report details.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The website ID that owns the custom report, or "all" for a shared report.

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to delete.

parameters.name: idSite

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to pause.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The website ID that owns the custom report, or "all" for a shared report.

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to resume.

get.description: Returns report categories and subcategories that can contain custom reports.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The website ID used to resolve available report pages.

200.description:
Available categories and subcategories for custom report placement.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

Available custom report types keyed by identifier and translated name.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

Available dimensions grouped by category.

get.description: Returns archived data for a configured custom report.

parameters.name: idSite
parameters.description: The website ID to query.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).

parameters.name: idCustomReport
parameters.description: The ID of the custom report to look up data for.

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.

parameters.name: expanded
parameters.description: Whether to expand recursive subtables in the response.

parameters.name: flat
parameters.description: Whether to flatten the report rows into a single level.

parameters.name: idSubtable
parameters.description: The subtable ID to fetch instead of the root table.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include in the response.

200.description:
The archived data for the requested custom report.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

GenericSuccessXml.description: Generic Matomo success payload in XML.

ErrorXml.description: Generic Matomo error payload in XML.

flatOptional.name: flat
flatOptional.description: Flatten subtables into the parent table.

filter_columnOptional.name: filter_column
filter_columnOptional.description: Column to apply the regex to (e.g., `label`).

filter_column_recursiveOptional.name: filter_column_recursive
filter_column_recursiveOptional.description: Column for the recursive regex filter.

filter_excludelowpopOptional.name: filter_excludelowpop
filter_excludelowpopOptional.description: Column to threshold and exclude low values.

filter_truncateOptional.name: filter_truncate
filter_truncateOptional.description: Row index after which rows are removed.

filter_limitOptional.name: filter_limit
filter_limitOptional.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

hideColumnsOptional.name: hideColumns
hideColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to hide.

showColumnsOptional.name: showColumns
showColumnsOptional.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include.

labelOptional.name: label

tags.name: CustomReports
tags.description: Exposes Custom Reports configuration and reporting endpoints. Use it to create, duplicate, manage, and query custom report definitions and their archived data.
